anonymous_pull_enabled.title: Anonymous Pull Enabled
anonymous_pull_enabled.description: Registry is configured to allow unauthenticated (anonymous) pull operations without requiring credentials.

anonymous_push_enabled.title: Anonymous Push Enabled
anonymous_push_enabled.description: Registry is configured to allow unauthenticated (anonymous) push operations, enabling any actor to inject or overwrite image layers without credentials.

network_exposure.title: Network Exposure Scope
network_exposure.description: Indicates the network boundary from which the registry is reachable, affecting the blast radius of unauthenticated or unauthorized access. Used across authentication, TLS, rate-limiting, and network exposure rules.

tls_enabled.title: TLS Enabled
tls_enabled.description: Whether the registry endpoint enforces HTTPS/TLS for all client connections, rejecting plaintext HTTP requests.

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version accepted by the registry endpoint.

certificate_valid.title: TLS Certificate Valid
certificate_valid.description: Whether the registry's TLS certificate is valid, not self-signed without trust anchoring, and not expired, enabling proper chain-of-trust verification by clients.

push_permission_scope.title: Push Permission Scope
push_permission_scope.description: The breadth of identities granted push (write) access to the registry or repository, indicating whether push rights are scoped to specific pipeline service accounts or granted broadly.

production_tag_overwrite_protected.title: Production Tag Overwrite Protection Enabled
production_tag_overwrite_protected.description: Whether production-critical image tags (e.g., 'latest', release tags) are protected from overwrite by enforcing immutability or requiring elevated approval.

push_identity_types_granted.title: Identity Types Granted Push Access
push_identity_types_granted.description: List of identity types that have been granted push permissions to the registry or critical repositories (e.g., pipeline_service_account, human_user, broad_group, wildcard, anonymous).

signature_verification_policy_enforced.title: Image Signature Verification Policy Enforced
signature_verification_policy_enforced.description: Whether the registry enforces a signature verification policy (e.g., Cosign, Notary v2/TUF) at pull time, blocking unsigned or signature-invalid images from being served.

signature_enforcement_mode.title: Signature Enforcement Mode
signature_enforcement_mode.description: The operational mode of the signature verification policy — 'enforce' blocks non-compliant images, 'audit' only logs violations, 'disabled' performs no verification.

trusted_signing_keys_configured.title: Trusted Signing Keys Configured
trusted_signing_keys_configured.description: Whether at least one trusted public signing key or certificate authority is explicitly configured in the signature verification policy for image provenance validation.

layer_secret_scanning_enabled.title: Layer Secret Scanning Enabled
layer_secret_scanning_enabled.description: Whether automated secret/credential scanning is enforced on image layers and history before images are accepted into the registry (e.g., via admission policy, CI gate, or registry-native scanner).

secrets_detected_in_layers.title: Secrets Detected in Image Layers
secrets_detected_in_layers.description: Count of hardcoded secrets, API keys, passwords, or certificates found embedded in filesystem layers or image history metadata across production images in the registry, as reported by the most recent scan.

image_pull_access_scope.title: Image Pull Access Scope
image_pull_access_scope.description: The breadth of principals authorized to pull images from the registry, determining how widely embedded secrets could be exfiltrated.

vulnerability_scanner_integrated.title: Vulnerability Scanner Integrated
vulnerability_scanner_integrated.description: Whether the registry is configured to integrate with a container image vulnerability scanner (e.g., Trivy, Clair, Anchore, Snyk) that automatically scans images on push or pull.

scan_on_push_enforced.title: Scan on Push Enforced
scan_on_push_enforced.description: Whether automatic vulnerability scanning is triggered and enforced on every image push to the registry, preventing promotion or pull of unscanned images.

promotion_gate_cve_threshold.title: Promotion Gate CVE Severity Threshold
promotion_gate_cve_threshold.description: The configured minimum CVE severity level that blocks image promotion from registry to production orchestration platforms. 'none' means no gate is configured.

credential_rotation_policy_enabled.title: Credential Rotation Policy Enabled
credential_rotation_policy_enabled.description: Whether an automated or enforced rotation policy exists for service account credentials/tokens used by CI/CD pipelines and orchestration platforms to authenticate to the registry.

credential_scope.title: Credential Sharing Scope
credential_scope.description: Whether the registry credentials used by pipeline/orchestration integrations are shared across multiple pipelines, projects, or environments, or are unique per integration.

credential_max_age_days.title: Maximum Credential Age (Days)
credential_max_age_days.description: The age in days of the longest-lived active registry credential (token or password) used by pipeline or orchestration integrations. A value of 0 indicates no expiry is set.

registry_network_exposure_scope.title: Registry Network Exposure Scope
registry_network_exposure_scope.description: The network scope from which the registry API and storage endpoints are reachable, indicating whether access is restricted to known trusted segments or open to untrusted networks.

network_policy_enforced.title: Network Policy Enforced
network_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether firewall rules or network policies explicitly restrict registry API and storage endpoint access to known CI/CD and orchestration platform CIDR ranges.

approved_source_cidr_ranges.title: Approved Source CIDR Ranges
approved_source_cidr_ranges.description: List of CIDR ranges explicitly permitted to reach the registry. An empty list indicates no allowlist is configured.

storage_encryption_at_rest_enabled.title: Storage Encryption at Rest Enabled
storage_encryption_at_rest_enabled.description: Whether the backend object storage or block volume used for image layer blobs and manifests has encryption at rest enabled (e.g., AES-256 via provider-managed or customer-managed keys).

storage_publicly_accessible.title: Storage Backend Publicly Accessible
storage_publicly_accessible.description: Whether the underlying storage backend (bucket, volume, or filesystem) is accessible from public networks without registry authentication, amplifying the risk of unencrypted storage.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether the registry has audit logging enabled to capture push, pull, delete, and authentication events.

logged_event_types.title: Logged Event Types
logged_event_types.description: The set of registry event types captured in audit logs. Expected values include push, pull, delete, and auth.

log_detail_fields.title: Log Detail Fields
log_detail_fields.description: Fields captured per log entry. Must include timestamp, client_identity, and image_reference to be forensically useful.

tag_immutability_enabled.title: Tag Immutability Enforcement Enabled
tag_immutability_enabled.description: Whether the registry enforces immutable tags, preventing any push client from overwriting an existing tag reference with a different image digest.

mutable_tags_in_use.title: Mutable Tag Names In Use
mutable_tags_in_use.description: List of tag names currently referenced by orchestration manifests or CI/CD pipelines that are inherently mutable (e.g., 'latest', 'stable', 'production') and do not pin to a specific digest.

garbage_collection_enabled.title: Garbage Collection Enabled
garbage_collection_enabled.description: Indicates whether automated garbage collection is configured and active on the registry, removing unreferenced blobs and manifests from storage.

retention_policy_configured.title: Image Retention Policy Configured
retention_policy_configured.description: Indicates whether an image retention policy is defined to automatically expire and remove old or untagged images and their associated layers after a defined period or count threshold.

registry_process_user.title: Registry Process User
registry_process_user.description: The OS user account under which the registry process or container runs (e.g., 'root', 'registry', 'nobody').

privileged_mode_enabled.title: Privileged Mode Enabled
privileged_mode_enabled.description: Whether the registry container is running in fully privileged mode, granting all Linux capabilities and bypassing most container isolation.

host_volumes_mounted.title: Host-Mounted Volumes
host_volumes_mounted.description: List of host filesystem paths bind-mounted into the registry container (e.g., ['/var/run/docker.sock', '/etc', '/data']).

added_linux_capabilities.title: Added Linux Capabilities
added_linux_capabilities.description: List of Linux capabilities explicitly added to the registry container beyond defaults (e.g., ['SYS_ADMIN', 'NET_ADMIN', 'DAC_OVERRIDE']).

version_has_known_cve.title: Version Has Known CVE
version_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the currently deployed registry software version is associated with one or more publicly disclosed CVEs in the NVD or vendor security advisories.

days_since_last_patch.title: Days Since Last Security Patch Applied
days_since_last_patch.description: Number of days elapsed since the registry software was last updated to a version containing a vendor security fix.

pull_rate_limiting_enabled.title: Pull Rate Limiting Enabled
pull_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether the registry enforces rate limits on image pull requests per client/IP/token to prevent resource exhaustion and abuse.

auth_endpoint_rate_limiting_enabled.title: Authentication Endpoint Rate Limiting Enabled
auth_endpoint_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether the registry or its authentication service enforces rate limits or lockout policies on login/token requests to prevent brute-force credential attacks.
